sql:
SELECT
  t.start_year AS year,
  ROUND(AVG(t.average_rating), 2) AS avg_rating
FROM titles t
WHERE t.title_type = 'tvSeries'
  AND t.start_year BETWEEN 2000 AND 2023
  AND t.average_rating IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY t.start_year
ORDER BY t.start_year ASC
summary: 共发现 0 个性能问题。SQL 已明确列出所需列，无 SELECT *、无笛卡尔积、无子查询、无函数包裹列、无 NOT IN、无 DISTINCT、无 LIKE 通配符、无 OR 条件。聚合查询（GROUP BY）返回行数有限（2000-2023 共 24 年），无需 LIMIT。SQL 性能良好，无需优化。
